props.name: row
props.comment: The stable-id row this wrapper scopes + controls.

props.name: disabled
props.comment: Hides this row's remove and reorder controls.

props.name: disableRemove
props.comment: Hides the remove button. A function decides per row index.

props.name: disableReordering
props.comment: Hides the move up / move down buttons.

props.name: inline
props.comment: Lays the row's inputs out in one line from the `sm` breakpoint up.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.comment:
A label for the row. `true` numbers rows from 1; a function returns the
label for the row index; `false` renders none.

slots.name: reorder-buttons
slots.type: { index: number; remove: () => void; reOrder: (to: number) => void; }

slots.name: remove-button
slots.type: { index: number; remove: () => void; reOrder: (to: number) => void; }
